theory.S3_V: V_dot = V' phi_dot: rises only while the field climbs; then phi_dot^2 falls (transient). rho_dot = -3H phi_dot^2 <= 0. theory.falling: eps falls <=> w > -1; -p falls (NEC) <=> c_a^2 < 0 (e.g. slow-roll thawing); V falls <=> field rolls down (V' phi_dot < 0).
